div.head: Wl art 8
div.ab: Omnis homo, qui voluerit se teneri pro libero, sit in plegio, ut plegius teneat et habeat illum ad iusticiam si quid offenderit;
Everyone who desires to keep the status of a freeman shall be in a frankpledge, so that the frankpledge may bring him to justice, if he has committed an offence.
